about: Evolution for the Godot version (docs/proposals/creature-catalogue-and-evolution.md section 2; DD-5; EVO-1). New forms and the ways creatures change, beyond the browser game's single level evolutions. Merged into the game data at start: species are added, and evos replace a species' old single evolution. Each evo: to, and at (the level; always required), and any of bond (an added trust step: 1 Friendly, 2 Loyal, 3 Devoted, 4 Bonded), place (a map), with (a species in your team), time, weather, ate, raised (care or battle) and raised_at (that record's trust step). Trust is added to the level. It does not replace it. The first matching option wins, so put special ones first and the ordinary one last. hint is what Maren thinks; the field book shows the first hint once you've seen the creature. bond_branch is the shape for CAT-2's future creature, not a creature you can meet yet. Starter lines are three stages and are never met in the wild. Ripplet becomes Riverwisp at level 16, then Tidewyrm at level 36 with Devoted trust. Cindercub becomes Smoulderpup, then Blazefang. Mosshog becomes Thicketboar, then Thornback. Deeptide, Pyremane and Elderthorn are retired. metres, on a new middle stage, is its height in metres at 12.35 pixels per metre.

smoulderpup.name: Smoulderpup
smoulderpup.dex: A lanky young wolf, always too warm to hold. Glowing cracks run down its spine, and it steams when the rain finds it.

riverwisp.name: Riverwisp
riverwisp.dex: Gangly and stretched, half swimming and half walking. Its neck frill hangs floppy, and it has not chosen the bank or the river.

thicketboar.name: Thicketboar
thicketboar.dex: Burly and shaggy, and the garden on its back has not settled. Saplings sprout lopsided, and it sheds twigs as it walks.

mistlynx.name: Mistlynx
mistlynx.dex: A Poolkit that grew up in the cloud of the high pass. It slips through fog without a sound and is gone before you see it move.

sunlynx.name: Sunlynx
sunlynx.dex: A Poolkit that grew up devoted to its tamer. Its coat holds the morning light, and it lies across the doorway at night to keep it in.

dawnchorus.name: Dawnchorus
dawnchorus.dex: A Mistfinch that greeted the dawn. Its song carries the first light.

duskwing.name: Duskwing
duskwing.dex: A Mistfinch that hunts at dusk. It flies without a sound.

rainback.name: Rainback
rainback.dex: A Brineskit raised in the rain. Water beads on its back and never falls.

gorgebelly.name: Gorgebelly
gorgebelly.dex: A Brineskit fed on fish. It grew broad and strong.

cindercub.hint: It grows lanky before the fire really wakes.

smoulderpup.hint: The fire breathes once it has grown, and only for a tamer it trusts.

ripplet.hint: It stretches between the bank and the river before it learns the tide.

riverwisp.hint: It becomes a river dragon once it has grown, and only for a tamer it trusts.

mosshog.hint: The garden on its back grows wild before it can settle.

thicketboar.hint: It carries a grove once it has grown, and only for a tamer it trusts.

poolkit.hint: Poolkit grows to suit its home. Raised in the cloud, it turns quiet.
A Poolkit devoted to its tamer grows warm and bright.
Most Poolkit become river cats. Most, not all.

mistfinch.hint: A Mistfinch that sees the dawn becomes something that sings with it.
A Mistfinch that flies at dusk learns the quiet ways.
Most Mistfinch become cloud harriers. Most, not all.

brineskit.hint: A Brineskit caught in the rain grows to love it.
A Brineskit fed on fish grows broad and strong.
Most Brineskit become shoal crests. Most, not all.

bond_branch.about: CAT-2 will name this creature and point these options at it. Not placed, and not a species yet. Every option asks for a level. care is trust from feeding, a festival or a letter; battle is trust from fights together. The same five steps as bond. Trust and how it was raised are added to that level. They do not replace it. First match wins, so the gentle final is listed before the keen one, and the ordinary level change is last. A save with no raised record takes the ordinary option.

options.hint: Cared for until it is Loyal, it grows gentle.
Raised in the fight until it is Loyal, it grows keen.
Left to grow up, it takes the ordinary form.
